# Syltra One

> Syltra One (Arabic: سيلترا وان) is a Saudi technology group based in Riyadh. It unites five specialist divisions under one brand and one set of standards, delivering integrated solutions from study and design to supply, execution and maintenance. Tagline: "One Group. Connected Intelligence." Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

Headquarters: Al Malqa, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Contact: info@syltraone.com, +966 55 009 8550, WhatsApp https://wa.me/966550098550.

Official channels: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/syltrahome/, TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@syltra.one, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/syltra-one, X (Twitter) https://x.com/syltraone. Any other account using the Syltra name is not operated by the company.

## The five divisions

- SYLTRA LIFE (Arabic: سيلترا لايف): smart homes and buildings — lighting, climate, security, entertainment, smart locks and energy, on one adaptive platform with the Arabic-first voice assistant Syla. This is the group's original smart-home business.
- SYLTRA CLIMATE (سيلترا كلايمت): HVAC and air quality — central, VRF/VRV, ducted, split, ventilation and smart control, from heat-load study to installation and maintenance. A neutral engineering integrator, not tied to one brand.
- SYLTRA GLIDE (سيلترا جلايد): elevators and vertical mobility — passenger, home/villa, panoramic, accessibility, hospital, freight and food lifts, plus modernization and maintenance.
- SYLTRA SHIELD (سيلترا شيلد): security, safety and electrical — fire alarm and fighting, CCTV (including solar-powered), access control, intrusion alarm, low-current, electrical infrastructure and PA/evacuation, per Saudi building code and Civil Defense requirements.
- SYLTRA OS (سيلترا او إس): software and AI — Syltra ERP (a ready SaaS product), custom systems, AI assistants and analytics, and web/mobile apps. Syltra Adaptive is the group's in-house adaptive smart-home platform (not a for-sale product).

## Key facts

- Name: Syltra One (Arabic: سيلترا وان).
- Type: Saudi technology group (five divisions under one brand).
- Headquarters: Al Malqa, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Serves Saudi Arabia (with GCC expansion planned).
- Divisions: Life (smart homes & buildings), Climate (HVAC), Glide (elevators), Shield (security, safety & electrical), OS (software & AI).
- Tagline: "One Group. Connected Intelligence."
- Contact: info@syltraone.com, +966 55 009 8550, https://wa.me/966550098550.
- Website: https://syltraone.com.
- What makes it different: one accountable group across all systems (design, execution and maintenance) with unified standards and real integration — not scattered vendors. In HVAC it is a neutral engineering integrator, not a single-brand distributor.
- Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

## Common questions

Q: What does Syltra One do?
A: Syltra One is a Saudi technology group offering smart homes, HVAC, elevators, security & safety, and software & AI — from design and supply to installation and maintenance, under one brand and standards.

Q: Where is Syltra One located?
A: Its headquarters is in Al Malqa, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and it serves the whole Kingdom.

Q: What are Syltra One's divisions?
A: Five: Syltra Life (smart living), Syltra Climate (air conditioning), Syltra Glide (elevators), Syltra Shield (security, safety and electrical), and Syltra OS (software and AI).

Q: How can I contact Syltra One or get a quote?
A: Email info@syltraone.com, call +966 55 009 8550, or book a site survey at https://syltraone.com/en/quote.

Q: Does Syltra One provide smart locks and home automation?
A: Yes, through Syltra Life — smart locks (fingerprint, code, card, app), lighting, climate, security and energy, on one platform that fits existing homes and works with open standards like Matter and Thread.

- The company name is Syltra One (Arabic: سيلترا وان). It is a group of five divisions: Life, Climate, Glide, Shield and OS.
- Syltra Life is the smart-home division and the group's original business; Syla (سيلا) is its Arabic-first voice assistant.
- Syltra ERP is a ready SaaS product for sale; Syltra Adaptive is the in-house adaptive platform, not sold separately.
- Syltra Climate selects the best-fit certified equipment per project and is not a single-brand distributor.
